en.t: The maids knew nothing about it.

units.source_text: 看见次日早晨拿出香盒去，几个亲近的侍女方始恍然大悟。

en.t: When they saw the incense box being brought out the next morning, several of the closer maids finally understood.

units.source_text: 香盒中盛饼的盘子，不知惟光是在何时准备好的。

en.t: No one knew when Koremitsu had prepared the dish in the incense box that held the cakes.

units.source_text: 盘子脚上雕刻非常精美，饼的样式也很别致，调度得十分讲究。

en.t: The legs of the dish were carved with extraordinary delicacy, the cakes were shaped in an unusual style, and everything had been arranged with great care.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母想不到公子如此郑重其事，心中非常满意。

en.t: The Shonagon nurse had not expected the young lord to treat the matter with such ceremony, and she was deeply pleased.

units.source_text: 想起了公子这无微不至的宠幸，不禁感激涕零。

en.t: Thinking of the young lord's favor, so attentive in every detail, she could not help shedding tears of gratitude.

units.source_text: 但侍女们私下互相议论：

en.t: But the maids discussed it privately among themselves:

units.source_text: “这等事情，悄悄地和我们商量才好。

en.t: "For such a matter, it would have been better if he had quietly consulted with us.

units.source_text: 现在托付这惟光，不知此人心中作何感想？”

en.t: Now that he has entrusted it to this Koremitsu, who knows what the man is thinking?"
